Greater London

Community Trust Co-Building with Migrants and Refugees: Part II

12 November 2026 @ 13:00PM
Open to Everyone
Free to Attend

Camden Town Hall

This panel follows from a session we held in September where our panellists provided research perspectives from across academic disciplines on the strengths and limitations of existing networks of migrant solidarity as well as strategies for building further trust.

Building on this academic insight, we now wish to foreground the work of civil society leaders, community workers, local government representatives, and those with lived experience in asylum and displacement to hear about how trust is actively being co-created with migrants and refugees in communities across London.

This event is part of "Building Community Trust Panel Series" panel series.
